# Template: screening_timeline
The natural history of a disease on a timeline — biological onset, the preclinical detectable phase, symptoms, death — compared with and without screening: screen detection moves diagnosis earlier, dashed guides show that symptoms and death do not move, and the highlighted span between them is the LEAD TIME, so "observed survival" grows without anyone living longer (lead-time bias). Choose this scene for ANY request about screening, early detection, lead-time bias, length bias, overdiagnosis framing, the preclinical detectable phase, or why survival statistics flatter screening.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "onset": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Time of biological onset (default 1)."
  },
  "detectable": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Time the disease becomes screen-detectable (default 2.5)."
  },
  "symptoms": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Time symptoms appear = clinical diagnosis without screening (default 5.5)."
  },
  "death": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Time of death (default 8.5)."
  },
  "screen_at": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Time of the screening test that catches it (default 3.5; clamped into the detectable-to-symptoms window)."
  },
  "compare": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Two rows, without vs with screening (default true). false = a single natural-history row without screening."
  },
  "time_unit": {
   "type": "string",
   "description": "Unit for the survival captions (default \"years\")."
  },
  "show_lead_time": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Highlight the lead-time span on the screening row (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axis: the time axis
- row_0: the without-screening timeline (row_1 = with screening, compare only)
- row_label_0: "Without screening" caption (row_label_1 likewise)
- onset_0: onset dot on row 0 (onset_1 likewise)
- detectable_0: tick where the disease becomes detectable
- dx_0: diagnosis tick on row 0 (at symptoms; dx_1 = at the screen)
- death_0: death cross on row 0 (death_1 likewise)
- survival_0: observed-survival bracket on row 0 (survival_1 likewise)
- sympt_guide: dashed vertical guide at symptom onset across both rows (compare only)
- death_guide: dashed vertical guide at death across both rows (compare only)
- lead_time: the highlighted lead-time span (compare only, when show_lead_time)
- label_onset: caption (when drawn; likewise label_detectable, label_dx_0, label_dx_1, label_death, label_survival_0, label_survival_1, label_lead)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Explain lead-time bias with a screening timeline." → params: {"title":"Lead-time bias"}
Request: "Draw the natural history of a disease: onset, detectable phase, symptoms, death." → params: {"compare":false,"title":"Natural history of disease"}

In YAML: `template: screening_timeline` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
